actualUnknownCoverage: Actual UNKNOWN outcomes retained with same-identity resolution
limitations: Single-host finite O1 workload, with full diagnostics enabled
No universal TPS, RTO, constant-memory, power-loss, cross-host or rolling-version claim
Queue/gate/writer/publisher costs remain in planned-arrival latency
Synthetic C06 controls are separate and never contribute runtime arrivals, attempts or trades

sizesAfter.allocationDefinition: Logical file lengths, not physical allocated disk blocks; filesystem sparse allocation is not inferred

stages.mainLatencyDefinition: One controller clock: frozen planned arrival to correlated application response, including scheduler, queue and dispatch-gate delay. UNKNOWN/queue refusals have separate accounting.
stages.offerTimingDefinition: Exact Aeron offer instant is not exposed. offerObservedAt is first controller observation of ingressOffersAccepted; the offer occurred within [invokeStartedAt,offerObservedAt].
